target: Headless Magritte-Model; source-derived semantic audit, not exhaustive method equivalence

nil_error_message.error: Nil error text has no String ValidationError representation

property_announcer.error: Property announcements are outside the stored-Value profile

boolean.error: Reference description is unavailable; retain it in the graph

single_option.error: Reference description is unavailable; retain it in the graph

priorities.P2-deferred: evidence work blocked only by the current no-GT preference
priorities.P3: later core families or platform verification
priorities.decision: optional package scope, not assumed implementation work

gaps.title: Inherited executable behavior for registered description subclasses
acceptance_gate: Register no-override subclasses of every implemented description family without editing library class-name lists.
Verify inherited kind, predicates, defaults, validation, readers/writers, metadata and visitor dispatch.
Preserve registered class identity through graph export/import when its behavior has an explicit supported binding; fail safely for unknown or unbound behavior.
Test explicit native overrides and reject serialization of executable closures.
scope_notes: Runtime class registration and discovery already work; this is not a request to replace that registry again.
Visitor dispatch and isSortable already walk inheritance; exact-name executable checks elsewhere are the gap.
Do not equate a registered class identity with implemented behavior or silently execute unknown code.

resolution.boundary: Concrete registered descendants of the 15 implemented families; graph/4 with receiver-side registration; local executable overrides remain local.

gaps.title: Default/self references and relation reference protocol
acceptance_gate: Unbound reference descriptions lazily retain the source default; Boolean reference returns the same Boolean description.
Test display propagation, repeated gets, explicit nil reset, copy, lifetime, generated IDs and graph ownership.
Implement relation allClasses/commonClass using the actual source rules, including empty classes; distinguish these from registry-wide discovery.
Resolve the relation reference fallback branch against pinned source and relevant platform extensions before specifying template behavior.
scope_notes: An explicitly bound reference already propagates display settings.
The superclass reference getter creates a nonnil String description before the relation getter tests for nil; do not infer an always-active automatic common-template intersection.
No GT access is authorized for this audit.

gaps.title: Container mutation and persistent priority ordering
acceptance_gate: Add source-shaped mutation operations with missing-element, duplicate/equality and return-value behavior.
Verify explicit source ordering traces before/after priority mutation, addition, setChildren and resort; reject priority-container moves.
Keep enumeration/composition behavior and graph round trips consistent with the chosen persistent state.
scope_notes: Direct children-vector/array mutation exists; it is not the full source collection protocol.
orderedChildren currently re-sorts a snapshot on every call; upstream uses a stored SortedCollection and explicit resort.
Shared mutable backing-collection identity is a separate MAG-004 acceptance gate.

gaps.title: Mutable collection identity, aliasing and memento snapshots
upstream_protocol: collection values shared by described objects
acceptance_gate: Represent shared mutable collections locally and test aliases, in-place mutations, cyclic membership and copy boundaries.
Replay checked/cached memento live-collection scenarios currently marked unsupported in editing-boundaries fixtures.
If collection identity is exported, define object-table representation and explicit legacy-format rejection; preserve current immutable/snapshot forms.
scope_notes: Description nodes and relationship objects already preserve reference identity/cycles.
Inline collections and strings are Values; copying their elements does not preserve collection-object identity.
This is a substantial foundation phase; a recursive deep clone is not an adequate substitute.

gaps.title: Validation protocol and nested error objects
acceptance_gate: Preserve nested error ownership/order and source validation continuation/short-circuit behavior in an explicit native result or error protocol.
Support container conditions with actual model targets and verify visible/read-only/undefined/kind gates.
Define nil error-message emission from source behavior without converting explicit nil to an arbitrary empty string.
Retain a flat-leaf compatibility projection and test memento consumers.
scope_notes: Current errors retain description ID, leaf code and String message; they do not model resumable Smalltalk exceptions.
A native continuation/result protocol can preserve observable behavior without implementing a VM.
Pinned upstream and previously inspected GT differ in undefined comparison and error arrangement; source is the target for this audit.

gaps.title: Interpreter selection, streaming and local customization
acceptance_gate: Bind selected native interpreter implementations with inherited dispatch and per-call state/error cleanup.
Test description-selected reader/writer/validator classes and local overrides, rather than only direct standalone visitor calls.
Specify faithful stream/message writer behavior before expanding portable formats.
scope_notes: Native Visitor subclassing already works; description-selected interpreter classes currently accept only the default names.
Arbitrary executable objects/blocks remain local and must not be serialized as runnable code.
Pinned MAMessagingStringWriter>>messageSend: includes application-specific employee/Halt debugging; investigate rather than port that dependency.

gaps.title: Property change announcements and the wider property-owner protocol
acceptance_gate: Add local source-shaped announcements with owner/key/new value and equality-based suppression.
Verify mutation/notification ordering, nil removal, subscription lifetimes, unsubscribe, reentrancy and failures.
Preserve explicit failure for exporting active subscriber/announcer state.
scope_notes: Stored property presence/nil/lazy operations already exist on Description.
The current profile refuses propertyAnnouncer, even explicit nil; arbitrary object-valued keys/values remain a separate Value-domain boundary.
Do not add an application/event-framework dependency.

gaps.title: Single-option groupBy protocol
acceptance_gate: Implement local accessor-valued grouping with source asAccessor conversions and absent-vs-explicit-nil behavior.
Verify nil setter creates a null accessor (isGrouped true), Symbol creates a selector accessor, and an existing accessor retains its identity.
Reconcile the annotated Symbol description with the accessor-valued getter before claiming metadata round-trip fidelity.
scope_notes: No core grouping-rendering algorithm is implied.
The source annotation uses MASymbolDescription while its setter stores an accessor; do not coerce the native getter to Symbol just to satisfy a fabricated schema.

gaps.title: Complete self-description for the executable native profile
acceptance_gate: Inventory annotated selectors and inherited overrides for every runnable native family; classify absent/suppressed/unsupported fields.
Verify metadata getters, editing, copy and recursive graph closure against those annotations, including grouped options and registered subclasses.
Keep condition and memento schemas empty where upstream annotations are actually empty; grow schemas only with source evidence.
scope_notes: Recursive description/accessor/memento sessions and bounded bootstrap already exist.
An open class/method registry does not automatically supply complete built-in description-object adapters.
New scalar/model families need corresponding schemas when implemented.

gaps.title: Temporal description/value families
acceptance_gate: Choose explicit native temporal kinds and source/platform parsing, timezone, range and precision rules.
Implement validation, reader/writer, metadata, equality/copy and portable tags with backward gates.
Test calendar boundaries, duration signs and round trips in both ports using source-derived cases.
scope_notes: Four temporal classes are present upstream but absent from the executable native profile.
Do not represent every temporal kind as an undocumented String or assume a particular timezone policy.

gaps.title: Numeric and Unicode/text profile completeness
acceptance_gate: First close or explicitly narrow the writer/reader round-trip contract for supported Fraction values.
Audit NumberParser and platform numeric dependencies before adding arbitrary integers, scaled decimals or richer syntax.
Treat Unicode inflection/case-insensitive matching as a separate coherent follow-on with locale/normalization rules and shared test data.
scope_notes: Int64, finite binary64 and bounded exact Fraction priority arithmetic already work.
Fraction 1/2 writes as (1/2), but both native number readers reject that output. This probe does not establish the exact upstream NumberParser grammar.
Exact mixed-number comparison is an explicit precision policy; do not replace it with lossy VM rounding.

gaps.title: Remaining domain descriptions and supporting models
acceptance_gate: Split into source-defined families; specify native host bindings before implementation.
Implement headless table and in-memory file model semantics separately from filesystem/UI adapters.
For each family test native behavior, schemas and safe serialization boundaries; document abstract/incomplete core definitions.
scope_notes: Seven additional description classes beyond the four temporal classes are outside the current executable profile.
Core class presence does not imply a complete concrete implementation; some kinds/concreteness come from platform packages.
Blocks are local callables unless a faithful portable representation is justified; no eval, UI or filesystem framework is implied.

gaps.title: Action descriptions and action pragma discovery
acceptance_gate: Implement the separate action model, priority/identity, enabled evaluation, invocation/culling and source property notifications.
Specialize existing method discovery for action pragmas and test inheritance/extensions with headless native targets.
Keep callbacks/local model state out of portable executable data; add no UI requirement.
scope_notes: MAActionDescription derives from MAObject, not MADescription.
Existing pragma infrastructure can be reused, but action behavior is not currently implemented.

gaps.title: Holders and remaining described-object/accessor utility protocols
acceptance_gate: Port source-shaped holders and their metadata when needed; distinguish real implementations from application test bindings.
Audit remaining extensions selector by selector, with local host binding where reflection/message dispatch is required.
Specify source hash/equality domains before exposing hashes; do not invent portable deterministic hashes or promise general equality/hash consistency.
scope_notes: initializeMagritte, isSameAs, printing, readToString and generic nil-read fallback are already implemented for documented profiles.
MAValueHolder/MADescriptionHolder registration tests bind application equivalents; registration alone is not the utility implementation.
Synchronous thread-local dynamic caches are implemented; Swift async task scopes are a platform decision, not an assumed core requirement.
The generic MADynamicVariable abstraction beyond the implemented description-cache/described-object scopes also needs a source-shaped native API if exposed.

gaps.title: Fresh live-reference evidence for later phases
acceptance_gate: Only after user authorizes GT again, fingerprint relevant live methods and compare source deviations explicitly.
Replay changed native semantics and cross-port graphs under the workspace CCNativeMcpLease/completion-marker workflow.
Record source-derived expectations separately from executed reference outcomes.
scope_notes: No GT tools were used in this audit.
Phases 0.1-0.16 have historical selected live-reference evidence; 0.17 captured selected sources but deferred fresh behavior/replay; 0.18-0.26 use source/native evidence.
This is an evidence gap, not proof that implemented behavior is missing.

gaps.title: Cross-platform and broader runtime verification
acceptance_gate: Run supported C++ toolchains/OSes and Swift platforms in CI with the shared fixtures.
Run applicable sanitizers/ownership checks and explicit concurrency/lifetime tests when those guarantees are claimed.
Maintain installed-consumer/public-API checks for semantic changes.
scope_notes: This audit executed macOS arm64 standalone suites only, with no fresh sanitizer or leak run.
No other OS, asynchronous dynamic-scope or concurrent mutable-builder safety claim follows from these results.

gaps.title: Optional upstream package scope
acceptance_gate: Decide package scope explicitly before assigning feature parity work beyond the headless core.
Treat Magritte-Merging auto-merge as separate behavior from checked-memento conflict/reset.
For an approved optional package, audit its source and platform dependencies before scheduling implementation.
scope_notes: FEATURES.md describes optional Magritte-Merging behavior; it is not a core completion checklist.
UI/Seaside/GT views, GemStone, filesystem adapters and money packages are separate scope decisions.
